title: Context Root
description: Shared header for many delta_packets. Stored once, referenced by ID from every packet that shares it. Per slm-learning-186/189.

benchmark.description: Benchmark / domain this root targets (humaneval / mbpp / gad_tools / kael_traces / bestiary / etc.)

model_family.description: HF id or family identifier (e.g. Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct)

target_contract.description: Output contract this root expects (function_definition / tool_action_json / bestiary_entry / etc.)

shared_instruction.description: The instruction prefix every delta_packet inherits. Composed at training-time as: shared_instruction + '\n\n' + delta.minimal_prompt

tokenizer_family.description: Tokenizer family (e.g. 'qwen2'). Used to validate token_budget at compose time.

allowed_tools.description: Tools/skills the model is allowed to call when responding under this root

eval_refs.description: Eval suites this root anchors to (humaneval, mbpp, etc.)
